mentions.name: Prolog TUI library
mentions.description: A TUI (terminal user interface) library for Prolog that sticks to relational/logical programming and aims to be conceptually simple, complete, and performant. It requires only core ANSI features that exist or are easily implemented in most Prologs, and already supports nested scrollable areas, toggles, frames, buttons, and layouts.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A Prolog TUI library that sticks to relational/logical programming, is conceptually simple, complete, and performant. 
Only requires some core ansi features that exist or are easily implemented in most Prologs.
Currently have stuff like nested scrollable areas, toggles, frames, buttons, layouts working.
